title: Increasing Repulsion Gain for Obstacle Avoidance
statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to the obstacles, potentially leading to a smoother traversal.
mechanism: The repulsion gain influences how strongly the robot avoids obstacles, which can affect its path planning and traversal speed.
